title: SG LLM Ops Summit — preflight, vendors & receipts runbook
content:
Context:
Quick personal runbook for SG LLM Ops Summit (speaker + team support). This is messy — notes to self, vendor numbers, expense workflow, and things to remember during travel. Use as single source while I'm out; will clean up and push a neat postmortem doc later.

Conference basics:
- Dates: 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-24 (main conference 23rd). Arrival: 22nd afternoon. Flight home: 25th AM.
- Venue: Marina Bay Convention Centre, Hall B. Badge pickup: 07:30–09:30 and 12:00–13:30 on 23rd (avoid 9:00–10:30 rush).
- My role: speaker slot 14:00–14:25 panel + 30 min office hours on expo floor 16:30–17:00 (Wednesday).

Preflight checklist (must before leaving):
- Travel approvals: confirm with finance that SG trip is approved under LLM-Ops-SG2026 (done 2026-02-10).
- Expense policy: confirm per-diem and meals — finance says per-diem SGD 80/day (covers meals + incidentals). Save copy of policy PDF to phone.
- Card: assign corporate card to Marco for shared invoices; I will use personal card for quick purchases and submit for reimbursement.
- Passport/visa: no visa required for stays <30 days for my passport. Passport valid >6 months.
- SIM: eSIM preloaded (Airalo SG data 5GB) — activate after landing. Note: local vendors M1 and Singtel have better booths at Changi (arrival hall D).
- COVID / health: no restrictions but pack rapid tests for team (2), Tylenol, bandaids.
- Upload boarding pass to Concur and attach to trip entry.
- Phone charger, HDMI->USB-C dongle for AV, backup battery, pocket speaker cable.

Logistics notes (on-site):
- Hotel: The Fullerton Bay Hotel — reservation under Redwood Inference, confirmation #FB-98712. Check-in 15:00, request early check-in but don't rely on it. Hotel invoice will be reimbursable under accommodation tag.
- Taxi vs Grab: use Grab for day runs; taxis recommended after 23:00. Estimated ride to venue SGD 20–35 depending on traffic.
- Speaker AV: AV check 30 min before session in Green Room — bring a USB-C laptop dongle + PDF and local copy of slides. Ask AV to test live demo connection to redwood-demo.red (ask SRE to open port on demo machine 2026-03-21).

Vendor & partner contacts (quick-dial and notes):
- On-site booth builder: ApexExpo Pte Ltd — contact Sophia Lim, +65 9123 9987, sophia@apexexpo.sg. Booth delivery window is Tue 21 10:00–18:00. Bring 6ft banner and printed one-pager.
- Catering/contact for sponsor dinner: BlueLotus Events — contact Jared Tan, +65 8122 3344. Menu needs vegetarian option; note gluten-free for Priya.
- Local transport (car service): RedRide Logistics — 24/7, +65 9123 4567 (ask for driver Ken). Used last year; invoice on corporate account.
- SIM kiosk (recommend for extra data): Changi M1 kiosk, Location: Terminal 1 arrivals. Contact: m1-retail@support.sg (walk-up only).

Expense capture process (my plan):
- Naming convention for receipts: SG2026_<YYYYMMDD>_<short> (e.g., SG2026_20260322_taxi-changi).
- Photo receipts immediately using Expensify mobile, tag with project: LLM-Ops-SG2026. If physical receipt > keep in envelope and upload when back.
- Per-diem: claim flat SGD 80/day; mark days 2026-03-22 (half day) as 0.5? Confirm with finance whether partial arrival counts — put query in ticket (ENG-1423).
- Foreign currency: report in SGD. For quick conversions use XE app; record card FX rate and bank fee separately if any.
- Splitting shared dinners: note who paid (Marco/Me/Priya) and capture each person's name in the note field for reimbursement splits.

Reimbursable vs non-reimbursable quick list (from policy):
- Reimbursable: flights (economy), hotel, conference pass, ground transport, team dinners (business purpose), demos & booth shipping, wifi at hotel, visas (if required).
- Not reimbursable: minibar, personal sightseeing, extra nights for vacation, alcohol above reasonable business dinner limit (check policy).

Receipts: special cases and tip reminders:
- Taxis: ask for e-receipt; if not available, take photo of printed receipt and note pickup/drop GPS (if possible).
- Booth build shipments: request itemized invoice (apexexpo) — we need HS codes? Not for our claim but request line items for finance.
- Sponsor swag purchases: cap $500 unless pre-approved. Tag as "marketing-swag" in expense.

Emergency / escalation contacts:
- Redwood security ops (on-call): security-oncall@redwood.ai, +1 415 555 0199 (US desk).
- Local embassy (my passport country): Embassy of India (if holder) — +65 6474 2200.
- Team WhatsApp group: +65-Redwood-LLM (create if not exists).

Open items / questions to resolve before departure:
- [ ] Confirm whether per-diem applies on travel days (ENG-1423 ticket).
- [ ] Set corporate card to authorize ApexExpo invoice — Marco to confirm card limit.
- [ ] Ensure demo machine port is open and reachable from Singapore network (SRE owner: @zhanglei).
- [ ] Talk to finance re: acceptable split receipts for team dinners (how to itemize).

Packing quick list (conference-specific):
- 2x collared shirts (panel), blazer, 2x casual tops, chargers, dongles, printed one-pager x50, stack of business cards (100), backup slides on USB, portable battery, 3 blank sticky pads for booth demos, extension cable (UK->SGC? check adapter).

Post-trip actions (when back):
- Upload all receipts to Expensify and submit under LLM-Ops-SG2026 within 7 days.
- Postmortem slide: attendance, talk feedback, demo latencies observed, vendor invoice tally, lessons learned about AV and demos.
- Reconcile booth shipping with accounting and tag as capital vs expense per finance guidance.

Random notes / fragments:
- Booth demo: minimize external calls — consider recorded demo fallback if live model latency spikes.
- Bring printed contingency credentials for demo machine (local user + creds).
- Possible follow-up with BlueLotus for team dinner photos for marketing.

Quick run-through timeline (my timeline on 23rd):
- 07:00 leave hotel for venue (breakfast on the go)
- 07:30 badge pickup + set booth materials in expo area
- 09:00 panel dry run (Green Room)
- 11:30 office hours prep + lunch with partner ops
- 13:45 AV check at stage + connect laptop
- 14:00 panel (14:00–14:25) + 14:30 back to booth for demos
- 16:30–17:00 office hours at booth

If anything falls through: default to recorded demo and collect contact emails for follow-up.

---
Notes to self: keep this doc alive and messy — it's my temporary memory. Will extract vendors and receipts SOP into a tidy Confluence child page if this trip is recurring.
